shots.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one landscape 16:9 CITY ENVIRONMENT image for an interactive exhibition, using the PROVIDED IMAGE as the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE. City background ONLY: absolutely no photographic people, no giant visitor, no hands, no faces, no mascots or other characters, no interface, no captions, no readable text, no watermark. Translate the reference's actual visual language into a new city, rather than copying its central creature or its exact set: eccentric rough handmade mixed-media photomontage, scanned antique prints, flat theatrical paper cutouts, discordant photographic red roses, thorny black botanical silhouettes, oversized butterfly-wing motifs, wrought-iron curls, old patterned wallpapers, mismatched frames, chessboard fragments, collage seams, deliberately inconsistent scale and perspective. Palette from reference: dirty sage and olive green, yellowed ivory, faded blue-gray, crimson rose red, sepia and ink black. Uncanny witch-labyrinth atmosphere, slightly grimy and bewildering, ornate but rough, NOT polished pastel fantasy, NOT a clean 3D miniature, NOT smooth digital concept art. Architecture must clearly read as a CITY with many houses, shopfronts, streets, bridges and windows, rather than only an indoor room or garden. No big central monster. Maintain readable route / open area for future interactive gameplay; visual ornament mostly frames that route. The image should look like an elaborate experimental stop-motion collage background with printed halftone and paper texture, no photoreal lighting. COMPOSITION: low street-level wide establishing view into a spacious empty olive-green town square. Cracked patterned paving and black thorn lines lead toward a distant narrow arched gateway in the center. Surround square with mismatched crooked multi-story antique apartment facades cut from old engravings, green-and-ivory wallpaper shopfronts, red cabinet-drawer-like tiny windows, blue gas streetlamps, ornate empty picture-frame balconies. Side and foreground clusters of large red photographic roses and black leaf silhouettes feel pasted over the city. Above, several elevated narrow streets curve across the sky like layered ribbons, with tiny rows of printed houses attached to them. One oversized butterfly wing forms the roof of a far right building. Keep center lower half relatively open, controlled stage-like depth, lavish distressed collage at edges, strongly reference-specific colors and roughness.
